title: Whole numbers in, decimal out
prompt: Both parameters are whole numbers, but the answer must keep its decimals: solve(7, 2) is 3.5. Return a divided by b.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> float:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	return a / b
hint: Turn one of them into a float before dividing. float() does that.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	return float(a) / b
